verdict_text:
NO

The merge formula violates the ordering requirement in Required result step 2. The script computes `tmp = b + λ(f1-b)` then `out = tmp + λ(f2-tmp)`, taking the second task vector against the already-modified `tmp` instead of the unmodified base `b`. Algebraically this yields `out = b + λ(f1-b) + λ(f2-b) - λ²(f1-b)`, introducing a spurious `-λ²(f1-b)` term not present in the required `base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-base)`. This is exactly the "arithmetic hazard" the spec warns against (each task vector must be taken against the unmodified base), and will push the 48 merged tensors' relative Frobenius error above the 1e-5 grading tolerance.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
